customManagers.description: Every version box installs: install/platform/versions.yaml. One key per component, and the comment on the line names the datasource and package the version comes from, so a bump is one line in one file and CI's e2e tests exactly what box ships. The shape is flat and the marker inline because both readers are then trivial: this regex here, and `sed` in the e2e (no YAML parser on the host). A value may be a whole image reference (`repository:tag@sha256:...`, which is the login's pin), so the digest is captured as currentDigest and the reference without it as currentValue: Renovate then reads both from the one line and bumps them together.

Test-only images the e2e runs, pinned by tag and digest in the scripts: box never installs them, so they stay where they are used. The `# renovate: datasource=docker` marker is what keeps Renovate off the e2e's own locally built image, which is tagged, never pinned.

packageRules.description: A platform pin or an e2e image changes what box installs: it is never automerged, whatever a preset later says.
